scope_note: This null result concerns the trial's categorical complete-remission outcome at 18 and 42 months. It neither proves equivalence nor licenses a verdict about other diagnoses, treatments, outcomes, or psychoanalytic theories.
statement: In TADS, complete remission was not significantly different between LTPP plus usual care and usual care alone either at treatment end or at 42 months.
statement_zh: 在 TADS 中，長期精神分析取向心理治療加常規治療與單獨常規治療，在療程結束及第 42 個月的完全緩解率都沒有顯著差異。
